channel.title: The Grant Desk - LatAm, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: LatAm, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Human Rights Watch: AI Strategy and Solutions Lead (one-year fixed term)
    https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/humanrightswatch/jobs/8350654002
    Human Rights Watch (HRW), Operations Department · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · USD 102,000 to 112,000 plus employer-paid benefits if based in the US; ranges outside the US are set by local market conditions. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 3 new grants - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Instituto Sacatar: Sacatar Fellowship 2027 (Bahia, Brazil)
    https://sacatar.org/en/fellowships/
    Instituto Sacatar · deadline Closed 28 Aug 2026 · Fully hosted residency: private bedroom with attached bathroom, three meals a day (except Saturday evenings, Sundays and Brazilian holidays), an individual studio suited to the discipline, weekly laundry, logistical support and airport transfer from Salvador. NO STIPEND, no airfare and no materials budget. USD 25 application fee. One French artist may additionally receive airfare and a stipend through Villa Fatumbi.
  • Fundacion Klemm: 29th Premio Klemm a las Artes Visuales 2026
    https://premioklemm.klemm.org.ar
    Fundacion Federico Jorge Klemm · deadline 04 Sep 2026 · First acquisition prize ARS 7,000,000 (around USD 4,800), second prize ARS 4,000,000 (around USD 2,750). No entry fee; the foundation pays transport of selected works.
  • Proimagenes Colombia: FDC 2026 Estimulos Automaticos
    https://www.convocatoriafdc.com/estimulos-automaticos
    Proimagenes Colombia (Fondo para el Desarrollo Cinematografico) · deadline 11 Dec 2026 · Six automatic-stimulus lines drawn from the FDC's 2026 pool of roughly COP 21,900 million (around USD 5.5 million). The feature film promotion line alone carries COP 3,620 million. Amounts per award are set per line. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 2 new grants - week of 27 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Red Quincho: Beca Constelaciones 2026 (4th Edition)
    https://redquincho.ar/beca-constelaciones-2026/
    Red Quincho · deadline Closed 09 Aug 2026 · ARS 1,000,000 (around USD 690) per grant toward mobility, living costs and production, plus one month of lodging. 15 grants available. No application fee.
  • Fundacion Ama Amoedo Grants 2026 (4th edition)
    https://www.fundacionamaamoedo.org/programas/becas
    Fundacion Ama Amoedo · deadline 09 Sep 2026 · Ten grants of USD 10,000 each, awarded annually across four categories: Artists, Art and Social Engagement, Organizations, and Publications. No application fee mentioned.
